prerequisites.label: Skill 30 - Fish Audio API reference (not used by drama song ads)
prerequisites.satisfy: NOT USED by drama song ads: Fish Audio (Skill 30) was the spoken-voiceover route in an earlier draft; spoken voiceover is now built as Skill 74 request JSON (a google/gemini-*-tts model) and dispatched through core/kie_dispatch (manual M2). Do not install Skill 30 for this skill and do not spend on Fish Audio; sung music never needed it.

prerequisites.label: KIE API Key
prerequisites.satisfy: KIE_API_KEY is the KIE.ai Market API bearer credential (Authorization: Bearer <KIE_API_KEY>). The env var NAME is repo convention (Skill 07 / Skill 66 precedent; KIE's own docs show only the literal placeholder YOUR_API_KEY). Confirm it is SET without printing the value: check ~/.openclaw/secrets/.env (Mac) or /data/.openclaw/secrets/.env (VPS), chmod 600, and openclaw.json env.vars. If absent, ask the operator to add KIE_API_KEY to ~/.openclaw/secrets/.env (chmod 600), then run: openclaw config set env.vars.KIE_API_KEY "$KIE_API_KEY". Do NOT mint a new key.

prerequisites.label: Fish Audio API key (not used by drama song ads)
prerequisites.satisfy: NOT USED by drama song ads: FISH_AUDIO_API_KEY (and FISH_AUDIO_VOICE_ID) were the spoken-voiceover credential in an earlier draft; spoken voiceover now rides Skill 74 with a google/gemini-*-tts model on KIE_API_KEY (manual M2), so no Fish Audio credential is ever needed. Do not mint, add or check a Fish Audio key for this skill.

prerequisites.label: Python 3 (control layer)
prerequisites.satisfy: python3 must be on PATH: the shared control layer (factory.py intake/preflight, state, ledger, QC gates) is Python 3 standard library only, no pip packages. Verify: python3 --version. If missing, install Python 3 (Mac: brew install python3; VPS: apt-get install -y python3) and re-run.

prerequisites.label: FFmpeg (assembly)
prerequisites.satisfy: ffmpeg must be on PATH: clip stitching, voiceover mux and the -14 LUFS finish ride FFmpeg (DEPENDENCY-MANIFEST section 3). Verify: ffmpeg -version. If missing: Mac brew install ffmpeg; VPS apt-get update && apt-get install -y ffmpeg. Rerun the check after install.

prerequisites.label: faster-whisper lyric-timing fallback (only when the tier-2 fallback is enabled)

check.note: F17 owner order 2026-10-08 (manual Part F F17, Critical): word timing comes from Suno's own timestamped lyrics via KIE ai-music-api/timeStamped-lyrics through core/kie_dispatch (tier 1, default, no local model). faster-whisper is the tier-2 LOCAL fallback, installed ONLY when this fallback is enabled, and it loads ONE model at a time in scripts/core/audio_c3/lyric_timing.py (one session per run, tracks transcribed one after another, small/medium int8); the Part D load guard (memory_guard, lane_size numbers) refuses a load past the machine's limit (LOCAL_MODEL_LOAD_REFUSED). NEVER openai-whisper (scripts/qc-no-local-asr.sh fails a hand-written whisper/asr script). Tier 3 is cloud speech-to-text with word timestamps on the CLIENT's own key only, never operator keys. Approved lyrics remain the source of truth; ASR output is timing/mismatch evidence only. Verified 2026-10-06 on the audited box: import faster_whisper -> ModuleNotFoundError; no pip on PATH; Python 3.14.7. Pin + hash arrive at release.

prerequisites.satisfy: Install faster-whisper ONLY when the tier-2 local fallback is enabled for a campaign (tier 1 Suno timestamped lyrics stays the default); pin per DEPENDENCY-MANIFEST section 3 at release. One model at a time in lyric_timing.py's WhisperSession; never openai-whisper.
